_comment: Seconds per Pester test file, measured in the 'Unit Tests: Pester' CI job (run 128767965254).
Used only to BALANCE the PR Checks shards (tools/pester/PesterShards.ps1); a file not listed weighs 0.3 s.
Stale numbers can only make the shards uneven, never skip a test. Refresh when one shard is clearly the slowest.
